info.name: AthenaVI Backend
info.description:
API collection for AthenaVI_backend.

**Environments** (import from `postman/environments/`):
- **Development (Local)** — `http://localhost:9000`
- **Development (Render)** — `https://athenavi-backend-jzns.onrender.com` (deployed test backend)

Select an environment in Postman before sending requests. Default collection `baseUrl` is local if no environment is selected.

**Auth:** Protected routes use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`. Run **Login** or **Register** first; the test script saves `accessToken` to collection variables.

**Refresh / Logout:** These use the `refreshToken` **httpOnly** cookie. In Postman, enable the cookie jar (default on) and run Login so cookies are stored for `baseUrl`.

**Multipart:** Workspace asset upload and profile image use `form-data` with the field names shown on each request.

**User settings** under **User → Settings**: appearance, notification, and security preferences (`/api/user/settings/...`). Bearer required. Delete account requires body `{ "confirmation": "delete" }`.

**Projects and renders** live under **Workspaces → Projects**. Use **Create project** first to save `projectId`, then **Save project data**, generate scene-level HeyGen clips if needed, and finally use **Renders** to start/export the final project video. **Start render** saves `renderId` to collection variables.

**HeyGen avatar videos (recommended order):** (1) **HeyGen → List avatar groups (public)** → saves `groupId`; (2) **List avatar looks (public group)** → saves `avatarLookId` (this is the **look** id, not the group id); (3) **List voices (public)** or design/clone → `voiceId`; (4) **HeyGen videos → Create avatar video** → saves `heygenVideoId` (starts HeyGen job only — `s3Key` is null until sync); (5) **Get HeyGen video** or **Download** (polls HeyGen, uploads MP4 to S3); (6) **Save project data** with `content.heygenVideoId` on avatar elements. **Get project** and **Save project data** also **rehydrate** missing `heygenVideoId` from `heygen_responses` when clips exist in S3.

**HeyGen (v3 proxy)** under **HeyGen**: with **`ownership=private`** / **`type=private`**, the backend filters HeyGen list responses **after** the upstream call. Only rows tied to **your** user in `heygen_avatars` / `heygen_voices` are returned. For video create, pass **`avatarLookId`** as `avatarId` (HeyGen look id, e.g. `lk_…`), not `groupId` (`ag_…`).

**Stock (Pexels)** under **Stock**: search then **Import stock into workspace** before using media in a project. Import returns a workspace `assetId` — use that in `project.data` elements (`content.assetId`), not Pexels CDN URLs. Requires server `PEXELS_API_KEY`.

**Storage** under **Storage**: user quota (`GET /api/user/storage`), upgrade requests, workspace footprint, and superadmin grant/revoke (`/api/superadmin/users/:userId/storage/*`). Byte fields are binary (1 GiB = `1073741824`). Grant with `tierId` (preset) or `additionalBytes` (increment any positive amount). See `docs/api/STORAGE_API.md` and `docs/api/SUPERADMIN_API.md`.

item.name: Projects
item.description: Project CRUD, editor state save, folder move, and final Remotion render APIs. List responses omit `data` and include owner, lastModifiedAt/By, storageBytes. **Get project** returns full `data`. **Get project** and **Save project data** rehydrate missing `content.heygenVideoId` on avatar elements from persisted HeyGen clips (by scene + request hash). Start render saves `renderId`. Run `npm run backfill:project-storage` after migration for existing rows.

request.description: Create Video wizard: canvas (aspectRatio) + details (title, tags, folderId). Workspace is :workspaceId in the URL. List folders: GET .../folders.
Optional: explicit data / projectState with videoSettings and pre-built scenes (advanced / editor import).
Summary cards only (no `data`). Includes owner, lastModifiedAt/By, storageBytes. Optional folderId query.

Returns `data.project` including editor `data` JSON. When HeyGen clips exist but avatar elements lack `heygenVideoId`, the server merges ids from `heygen_responses` (and may restore a placeholder avatar element) and persists repairs to the DB.

PATCH full V2 editor `data`: scene `presenter` / `generation`, element `style`, `filters`, `timing` or flat `startFrame`, `clips` alias for `elements`. Server keeps all fields (no strip). HeyGen: `generation.heygenVideoId` + `presenter.script` / `avatarId` / `voiceId`. Do not persist `blob:` or `generatedVideoUrl` for playback. Sample body uses legacy flat shape; frontend may send richer V2 per README.
Moves the project and migrates folder-aware S3 keys for HeyGen scene clips, cached scene renders, and final exports.
Queues a background Remotion render. The backend resolves assetId references, checks HeyGen avatar clips, reuses scene cache when possible, and writes the final MP4 to S3.
Returns a fresh presigned URL for the final MP4. This succeeds only when render status is `completed`.

item.name: HeyGen videos (project)
item.description: HeyGen scene clips for a project. **Create** only starts the job (`s3Key` null). **Get** / **Download** / **Stream** poll HeyGen and copy the finished MP4 to S3: `workspaces/…/scenes/{sceneId}/heygen/{heygenVideoId}.mp4`. Requires **HEYGEN_API_KEY** + AWS S3 env. Use `avatarLookId` (look id from **List avatar looks**), not `groupId`.

request.description: 201 — Starts HeyGen render; saves DB row (`status` often `processing`, `s3Key` null). **`avatarId`** = look id (`avatarLookId`). **`avatarEngine`**: `avatar_iv` (default) or `avatar_v` — must match look `supported_api_engines`. Set **`avatarType`** from the look row. **`expressiveness`**: Avatar IV + `photo_avatar` only. Call **Get HeyGen video** to sync S3. Match `sceneId` / `script` with **Save project data**.

item.name: Get HeyGen video (poll + sync to S3)

request.description: Default sync on: polls HeyGen (bounded ~50s), downloads MP4 to S3 when `completed`, updates `s3Key` / `status`. Repeat if still `processing`. Response `data.heygenVideo` includes `id`, `status`, `s3Key`.
Returns `bucket`, `key`, `region`, `objectArn` for `GetObject` with IAM. No secrets. 409 until file is in S3.
409 if not ready. `presignedUrl` in response is short-lived; call again to refresh. Optional query `expiresIn` seconds: **60–3600** (server default **300** if omitted).
Pipes S3 through API; same path does not expire like presigned URLs. Use `fetch` + blob `src` for `<video>` (native `src` cannot send Bearer). Optional `Range` header for seeking.

item.name: Speech (project)
item.description: Audio-only TTS per scene via HeyGen Starfish. MP3 stored at `workspaces/…/scenes/{sceneId}/speech/{speechId}.mp3`. Workspace-scoped credits (`speech_generation`).

request.description: 201 — Synchronous TTS; returns completed row with `s3Key`. Idempotent on scene + voice + script.
Optional query `source`: `upload` | `stock` | `all` (default all).

item.name: Stock
item.description:
Stock library: Pexels (photos + videos), Unsplash (photos), Pixabay (photos + videos). Requires at least one of `PEXELS_API_KEY`, `UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY`, `PIXABAY_API_KEY` on the server.

**Flow:** (1) **Search stock** — default `provider=all` merges all photo providers; videos merge Pexels + Pixabay; (2) **Import stock into workspace** — downloads from provider, copies to S3, creates workspace `Asset`; (3) reference `asset.id` in project JSON as `content.assetId`.

request.description: Set `stockExternalId` from a search result `externalId`, or replace manually. Saves `assetId` on success.

item.name: HeyGen
item.description:
HeyGen v3 proxy (`/api/heygen`). One shared HeyGen API key: **`ownership=private`** (avatars) and **`type=private`** (voices) trigger **server-side filtering** of the HeyGen JSON so each JWT user only sees rows recorded for them in **`heygen_avatars`** / **`heygen_voices`**, plus optional **`workspace_id`** to merge assets **shared to a workspace** (`heygen_workspace_shares`). Public lists are unchanged passthrough.

**403** (`You do not have access to this HeyGen resource`) — avatar consent for another user's group, GET voice by id for another user's **stored** private clone, private looks with another user's `group_id`, or scene video create with unshared private avatar/voice.

item.name: Workspace sharing
item.description: Share your avatar group or private voice with a TEAM workspace (`/api/workspaces/:workspaceId/heygen/...`). Requires avatar/voice owner for POST share.

item.name: Storage
item.description: User storage quota, ledger, upgrade requests, workspace footprint, and superadmin grant/revoke. All `*Bytes` fields are binary bytes (1024³ per GiB). Superadmin grant: `tierId` sets absolute preset (`free`, `plus_10gb`, `pro_50gb`) or `additionalBytes` increments limit by any positive amount.

request.description: Current user quota: limitBytes, usedBytes, availableBytes, percentUsed, tier, activeUpgradeRequest.
Storage ledger. Optional query: page, limit, type (initial | platform_grant | platform_revoke | purchase).
Upgrade request history. Optional query: page, limit, status (pending | approved | rejected).
Emails platform superadmin. requestedAdditionalBytes must equal requestedAdditionalGb × 1024³. Does not change quota until admin grants.
